shortDescription: An encrypted diary with offline semantic search. No ads.
fullDescription:
Keep your thoughts, events and memories in a personal diary that runs on your device. Semantic search helps you return to an entry even when you cannot remember its exact words.

A PLACE TO WRITE
• Entries with date, time, mood and tags.
• Automatic draft saving with cursor recovery.
• A calm editor with large text; mood and tags live in the expandable Details menu.
• Calendar, favorites and On this day memories.
• A 30-day trash folder and undo after deletion.
• Optional local reminders to write and create a backup.

SEARCH BY WORDS OR MEANING
• Find fragments within words and tags.
• Semantic search in English and Russian.
• Filter by dates, mood and tag.
• Open the matching fragment in the editor.
The model and tokenizer are included in the app; no model download is needed after installation. Semantic search is approximate: it may miss relevant entries or return entries on nearby topics.

PROTECTION FOR YOUR ENTRIES
Entries, drafts and search vectors are stored in an encrypted database on your device. A PIN protects access to the app, with optional biometrics. Automatic locking, protection against ordinary screenshots and hidden content in the recent-apps preview help keep writing private.
The app contains no ads, analytics, accounts, cloud sync or INTERNET permission. Entry text is not sent to the developer.

IMPORT, EXPORT AND BACKUPS
Import individual TXT/Markdown files, export entries as a Markdown ZIP, or create an encrypted backup with your own password. Export starts only when you choose it. Markdown ZIP files are plain text; a system file provider you select may be a cloud service.

The app is purchased through the store before installation. There are no subscriptions or in-app purchases; its features work without a network connection.

Please note: the PIN and backup password cannot be recovered. Drafts and trash are excluded from exports. The local model needs available storage and memory; speed depends on your device.

Android 8.0 or later. English and Russian interface, with light and dark themes.
